bundle.shortDescription: A standalone coding sandbox for Rust, Python and JavaScript
bundle.longDescription: Code Sandbox is a standalone desktop coding sandbox. Write Rust, Python or JavaScript in a CodeMirror 6 editor with VIM mode, run it on the fly without saving to disk, and save the result to any location you choose.
